# Single-cell analysis - General classification

Here, we will perform the second single cell analysis steps, including phenotyping immune and stromal cells.

## Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")
sce
```

## Filter sce for immune cells

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
#based on analysis categories
sce <- sce[,colData(sce)$analysis_cat == "non_tumor"]
sce
```

# 1. GMM 

## GMM scores per immune subtype

```{r}
## For non_epithelial cells 

# Convert the data.frame 
data_dt <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select("CD31_vWF_GMM","SMA_GMM", "CD3_GMM","CD4_GMM","CD8a_GMM","CD38_GMM","MPO_GMM","CD11c_GMM","CD20_GMM", "CD68_GMM") 

data_numeric <- data_dt %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(str_detect(., "_pos"))))

data_numeric_out <- data_numeric %>% 
  mutate(CD11c_CD68_GMM = ifelse(CD11c_GMM | CD68_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # Macro = CD11c or CD68
  mutate(CD11c_CD68_GMM = ifelse(MPO_GMM, 0, CD11c_CD68_GMM)) %>% # Neutro = MPO (independent of CD11c or CD68)
  mutate(CD3_CD4_GMM = ifelse(CD3_GMM & CD4_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # CD4 = CD3 AND CD4
  select(-CD11c_GMM,-CD68_GMM, -CD3_GMM, -CD4_GMM) %>% 
  mutate(sum = rowSums(.)) %>% filter(sum == 1) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:9, names_to = "GMM", values_to = "count") %>% 
  filter(count == 1) %>% select(cell_id, GMM)

data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD31_vWF_GMM"] <- "Endothelial"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "SMA_GMM"] <- "Stromal"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD3_CD4_GMM"] <- "CD4_T_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD8a_GMM"] <- "CD8_T_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD38_GMM"] <- "Plasma_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "MPO_GMM"] <- "Neutrophil"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD20_GMM"] <- "B_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD11c_CD68_GMM"] <- "Macrophage"

#Add to sce
sce$GMM_immune_combined <- data_numeric_out$GMM[match(sce$cell_id, data_numeric_out$cell_id)]

sce$GMM_immune_combined[is.na(sce$GMM_immune_combined)] <- "Unknown/Other"

# GMM per category
GMM_sum <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(GMM_immune_combined) %>% dplyr::count()
GMM_sum
```


# 2. Clustering

## Define markers for clustering

```{r immune_markers, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# We will again use predefined markers 
rowData(sce)$sub_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD31_vWF","SMA","CD45RO_RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")
```

## Run clustering

### Graph-based 

Next, we will run Rphenoannoy (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm) clustering with different resolution parameters. 

```{r cluster, message=FALSE}
library(Rphenoannoy)
set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$sub_cluster,])

#k=30
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 30)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_30 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_30)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

gc()

#k=50
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 50)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_50 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_50)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

gc()

#k=70
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 70)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_70 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_70)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

gc()

#k=90
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 90)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_90 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_90)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

gc()

#k=110
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 110)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_110 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_110)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

gc()

#k=130
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 130)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_130 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_130)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

gc()
```

### FlowSOM

```{r}
library(CATALYST)

# Run FlowSOM and ConsensusClusterPlus clustering
set.seed(220410)
sce <- cluster(sce, 
               features = rownames(sce)[rowData(sce)$sub_cluster],
               maxK = 30)

# Assess cluster stability
delta_area(sce)

delta_area(sce)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,0.01), xlim = c(4, 25))# select k = 8

saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")
```

```{r}
# Delete old clusters from broad classification 
clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_som_[:digit:]")] 
for(i in clusters){
  colData(sce)[,i] <- NULL
}

# Add new SOM clusters to SCE (select pretty high k for "overclustering")
sce$cluster_som_14 <- cluster_ids(sce, "meta14")
sce$cluster_som_16 <- cluster_ids(sce, "meta16")
sce$cluster_som_18 <- cluster_ids(sce, "meta18")
sce$cluster_som_20 <- cluster_ids(sce, "meta20")
```

### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_04.rds")


my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_[:digit:]")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,2]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "cluster")
}


my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_som_[:digit:]")]

df_1 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,3]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "cluster_som")
}


df_out <- rbind(df)


p1 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

p2 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")


p3 <- ggplot(df_out, aes(x=k, y=sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  
p1+p2+p3 
```


```{r clustree, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering and GMM
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

#Pairwise rand index 
#Agreement between two clustering approaches - ARI > 0.5 = "good" similarity
pairwiseRand(sce$cluster_90,sce$cluster_130, mode = "index")
```

# 3. Astir for automated cell type assignment 

### Astir model

see [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471221003355?via%3Dihub) for full publication (Geuenich et al.,2021, Cell Systems).

```{r astir-expo}
#Export arsinh normalized expression matrix as csv
expr_astir <- assay(sce,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(PID = sce$PID)

write.csv(expr_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/expr_ccRCC_immune_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)

#Export design matrix 
design_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID)

write.csv(design_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/design_ccRCC_immune_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

`Next: Run Astir in Python.`

```{r astir-ana, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Import Astir cell type assignments
astir_type <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/astir_ccRCC_immune_celltypes_TME.csv",col_names = c("ID","cell_type"),skip = 1)

astir_sum <- astir_type %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% dplyr::count()

# Add to sce
sce$astir_immune_type <- astir_type$cell_type[match(sce$cell_id, astir_type$ID)]

# Create combined category
sce$astir_immune_combined <- ifelse(sce$astir_immune_type %in% c("Unknown","Other"), "Unknown/Other", sce$astir_immune_type)

sce$astir_immune_combined[sce$astir_immune_combined %in% c("Macro","Macro_DC")] <- "Macrophage"    

#Mark channels used for cell type assignment 
astir_immune_channel = c("CD3","CD4","CD8a", "CD68", "CD11c", "MPO", "CD31_vWF", "SMA", "CD38","CD20")

rowData(sce)$use_astir_immune <- rowData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(use_astir = ifelse(rownames(sce) %in% astir_immune_channel,TRUE,FALSE)) %>% pull(use_astir)
```


### Visualization 

```{r}
# per combined type 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$astir_immune_combined,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$use_astir_immune)

Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")), col = viridis(110), clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells))
```
```{r}
nr_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster_130, astir_immune_combined) %>% table()
fr_astir <- as.data.frame(nr_astir) %>% group_by(cluster_130) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 

fr_astir <- fr_astir %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_130,names_from = astir_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_130")
```

Note: NK cells are not correctly identified by astir. (Kick CD56 out of marker file)

### cytoviewer visualization

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds")
```

```{r}
# Select images of interest
set.seed(22)
cur_sample <- sample(unique(sce$sample_id), 30)

cur_sample <- sample(colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, subtype_combined) %>% unique() %>% filter(subtype_combined == "ccRCC") %>% pull(sample_id), 30)

cur_sample <- (colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, astir_immune_combined) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% filter(astir_immune_combined == "B_cell") %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(sample_id))[1:10]

cur_sample <- (colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, cluster_1_130) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% filter(cluster_1_130 == "11") %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(sample_id))[1:10]

cur_sample <- (colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, immune_metacluster) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% filter(immune_metacluster == "CD8_T_cell") %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% pull(sample_id))[1:10]

cur_images <- images[mcols(images)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_masks <- masks[mcols(masks)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
```


```{r}
library(cytoviewer)
cytoviewer(image = cur_images, mask = cur_masks, object = cur_sce, img_id = "sample_id", cell_id = "ObjectNumber")
```


# 4. Immune metacluster tests

### Heatmap 

#### Based on SOM 

Heatmap of clusters with ASTIR information 

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
sce$cluster_selected <- sce$cluster_som_14
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$sub_cluster)

other_immune <- c("CD16","HLADR","TMEM173","CD303","CD163","IDO1","DCLAMP","CD11b","CD73","MMP9","CCR2","CD274","Arginase","CXCL13","CD33","VISTA","CD209", "CD206")
rowData(sce)$other_immune <- rownames(sce) %in% other_immune

other_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$other_immune)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_selected = spatial$cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir/GMM prediction 

## Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected,astir_immune_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = astir_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Create colors for astir cell types 
astir_col <- setNames(
  c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Endothelial", "Stromal", "Macrophage","Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell","B_cell","Unknown/Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col <- astir_col
metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col <- metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col[match(colnames(astir_anno),names(metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col))]


## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected,GMM_immune_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = GMM_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Create colors for GMM cell types 
GMM_col <- setNames(
  c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Endothelial", "Stromal", "Macrophage","Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell","B_cell","Unknown/Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col <- GMM_col
metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col <- metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col[match(colnames(GMM_anno),names(metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col))]


ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  astir_immune_combined = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col)),
  GMM_immune_combined = anno_barplot(GMM_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(3,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 2.3 Metadata features

#Number of cells per cluster_selected 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster_selected, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected,PID) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

# Proportion of ISUP grade per cluster
ISUP <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected,ISUP) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP <- ISUP %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP <- ISUP %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = ISUP,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected,pT_simple) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = pT_simple,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP = anno_barplot(ISUP, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP)),
                            pT = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_simple)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Assign labels to clusters 

anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster_selected, ncells)

anno <- anno %>% mutate(metacluster = ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("11","13"),"CD8_T_cell",
                                     ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("14"),"B_cell",
                                                   ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("12"),"CD4_T_cell",
                                                          ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("9"),"Plasma_cell",
                                                                        ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("5"),"Neutrophil",
                                                                               ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("6","4"),"Macrophage",
                                                                                      ifelse(cluster_selected %in% c("3","1"),"Stromal","Unknown/Other")
                                                                                      ))))))) %>% mutate(metacluster = as.factor(metacluster))


### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),
        col = col_main,
        name = "min-max",
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, 
        row_split = anno$metacluster,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  Heatmap(t(assay(other_mean_sce, "min_max")), col = col_main)+
  ha_astir_GMM+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

# Create legends for annotation 
lgd <- Legend(title = "Astir", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col))
lgd_2 <- Legend(title = "GMM", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd, lgd_2))
```

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
other_immune <- c("CD16","HLADR","TMEM173","CD303","CD163","IDO1","DCLAMP","CD11b","CD73","MMP9","CCR2","CD274","Arginase","CXCL13","CD33","VISTA","CD209", "CD206")

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_selected = spatial$cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")
```

1. T cells 

```{r}
##Visualize clusters on images - select 30 images for each category with highest number of cells
library(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores = 2)

#for(i in c("immune_metacluster_graph_test","immune_metacluster_SOM_test")){
for(i in c("immune_metacluster_graph_test")){

cur_sample_1 <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by({{i}}) %>%
  filter(.[,i] == "CD8_T_cell") %>%
  count(sample_id) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice(1:15) %>%
  pull(sample_id)

cur_sample_2 <- colData(sce) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by({{i}}) %>%
  filter(.[,i] == "CD4_T_cell") %>%
  count(sample_id) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice(1:15) %>%
  pull(sample_id)

cur_sample <- unique(c(cur_sample_1, cur_sample_2))

#Subset data
cur_images <- images[mcols(images)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_masks <- masks[mcols(masks)$sample_id %in% cur_sample]

cur_sce <- sce[,sce$sample_id %in% cur_sample]
cur_sce <- cur_sce[,colData(cur_sce)[,i] %in% c("CD8_T_cell", "CD4_T_cell")]

#Prepare images
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, separateImages = TRUE)
cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images, inputRange = c(0, 0.2))

plotPixels(cur_images,
           mask = cur_masks,
           object = cur_sce,
           img_id = "sample_id",
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
           missing_colour = "white",
           colour_by = c("CD8a","CD4"),
```

## 5. Immune metacluster 

#### Defintion

For downstream analysis, we will use SOM-Astir-GMM based immune metacluster assignment. 

```{r}
sce$immune_metacluster <- unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster_graph_test)

sce$immune_metacluster[sce$immune_metacluster == "Unknown/Other"] <- "Unknown_Other"
sce$immune_metacluster <- factor(sce$immune_metacluster) 

#Create colors for astir cell types 
immune_meta_col <- setNames(
  c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Endothelial", "Stromal", "Macrophage","Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell","B_cell","Unknown_Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster <- immune_meta_col
```

#### Visualization 

#### Rich heatmap 

```{r}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_ccRCC_MY_immune_05.rds")

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$immune_metacluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$sub_cluster)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#Select spatial features and average over immune_metaclusters 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, immune_metacluster)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-immune_metacluster) %>% aggregate(by = list(immune_metacluster = spatial$immune_metacluster), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir prediction 

# Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,astir_immune_combined) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = astir_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,GMM_immune_combined) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = GMM_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  astir_immune_combined = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$astir_col)),
  GMM_immune_combined = anno_barplot(GMM_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$GMM_col)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(3,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 2.3 Metadata features

#Number of cells per immune_metacluster 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(immune_metacluster, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

# Proportion of ISUP_combined grade per cluster
ISUP_combined <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,ISUP_combined) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP_combined <- ISUP_combined %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = ISUP_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,pT_combined) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = pT_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

# Proportion of necrose per cluster
necrose <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,necrose) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
necrose <- necrose %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
necrose <- necrose %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = necrose,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

PDL1_score <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,PDL1_score) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
PDL1_score <- PDL1_score %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = PDL1_score,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_barplot(ISUP_combined, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined)),
                              pT_combined = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined)),
                            necrose = anno_barplot(necrose, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$necrose)),
                            PDL1_score = anno_barplot(PDL1_score, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Annotation dataframe

anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(immune_metacluster, ncells)

anno$immune_cat <- ifelse(anno$immune_metacluster %in% c("Stromal","Endothelial"), "Stromal", 
       ifelse(anno$immune_metacluster == "Unknown_Other", "Undefined", 
              ifelse(anno$immune_metacluster %in% c("Macrophage", "Neutrophil"), "Macrophage", "Lymphoid")))


### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs")),
        col = col_main,
        name = "exprs",
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, 
        row_split = anno$immune_cat,
        cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
        row_title = NULL,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2"
        )+
  #Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "exprs"))))+
  ha_astir_GMM+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

# Create legends for annotation 
lgd <- Legend(title = "Immune metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
```

```{r}
# per type
other_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$immune_metacluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$other_immune)

Heatmap(t(assay(other_mean_sce, "min_max")), row_split = anno$immune_cat, col = viridis(100))+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(other_mean_sce, "min_max"))))+
```

#### Complex fraction stacked barplot

```{r}
## PID immune_metacluster fraction dataframe
PID_immune_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_immune_metacluster <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
cur_df <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID", names_from = "immune_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

# Perform hierarchical clustering on fractions
dd <- dist(cur_df, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order

# Define annotation dataframe
cur_df <- cur_df[row_sorted,]
anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(PID, gender, age_bin, ISUP_combined, pT_combined, necrose) %>% unique()
anno <- anno[match(rownames(cur_df), anno$PID),]

# Plot annotation dataframe with ComplexHeatmap
fraction_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  MC_fractions = anno_barplot(cur_df, gp=gpar(fill=metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster[colnames(cur_df)]),
                                   bar_width = 1,
                                   height = unit(25,"cm"),
                                   width = unit(11,"cm"),
                                   show_row_names = FALSE), 
                          PID = anno_simple(anno$PID, col=metadata(sce)$colors$PID, border=TRUE),
  gender = anno_simple(anno$gender, col = metadata(sce)$colors$gender, border = TRUE),
                          age = anno_simple(anno$age_bin, col = metadata(sce)$colors$age_bin, border = TRUE),
                          grade = anno_simple(anno$ISUP_combined, col = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined, border = TRUE),
                          pT = anno_simple(anno$pT_combined, col=metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined, border=TRUE),
                          necrose = anno_simple(anno$necrose, col=metadata(sce)$colors$necrose, border=TRUE),
                          border = TRUE, 
                          #annotation_name_rot = 90,
                          gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                          which = "row")

# Create legends for annotation 
lgd_1 <- Legend(title = "Immune MC", 
              at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster))

# Draw heatmap
draw(fraction_anno + NULL, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_1))
```

#### Fraction correlation 

```{r}
# METACLUSTER 

## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_metacluster <- SID_metacluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_metacluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_metacluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")
#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient 
n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_metacluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_metacluster_cor) 
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_metacluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_metacluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_metacluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

# Filter samples with 1 image only - Correlation = NA 
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(n_images > 1)

SID_metacluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_metacluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of metacluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_metacluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_metacluster_cor_plot

#CLUSTER 
## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_cluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(cluster_selected,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_cluster <- SID_cluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_cluster_cor <- SID_cluster
SID_cluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_cluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_cluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_cluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")
```

#### Extract images 

```{r}
images <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/images.rds")
masks <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/masks.rds")
```

#### Differential expression analysis 

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# Myeloid category
sce$myeloid_other <- ifelse(sce$immune_metacluster %in% c("Macrophage","Neutrophil"), "Myeloid","Other")

# Myeloid relevant markers 
other_immune <- c("CD16","HLADR","TMEM173","CD303","CD163","IDO1","DCLAMP","CD11b","CD73","MMP9","CCR2","CD274","Arginase","CXCL13","CD33","VISTA","CD209", "CD206")

# 1. Aggregate expression per PID and category 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce,
                                 ids = DataFrame(sce$PID, sce$myeloid_other),
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs")


# 2. Calculate log2FC 
## Aggregate per category 
mean_sce_1 <- aggregateAcrossCells(mean_sce, 
                     ids = mean_sce$sce.myeloid_other, 
                     statistics = "mean",
                     use.assay.type = "exprs")

logFC <- log2(assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce.myeloid_other == "Myeloid"]/assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce.myeloid_other == "Other"])

# 3. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
exprs <- as.data.frame(t(assay(mean_sce)))

exprs$myeloid_other <- mean_sce$myeloid_other

p_value <- c()
for (i in 1:(length(colnames(exprs))-1)) {
  t <- t.test(exprs[exprs$myeloid_other == "Myeloid",i], exprs[exprs$myeloid_other == "Other",i])
  p_value[i] <- t$p.value
}
## Adjust p.value 
p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(exprs)[1:43]

# 4. Plot VolcanoPlot 
data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value_adj))
#data <- data[which(rownames(data) %in% other_immune),]

keyvals <- ifelse(
   data$logFC < -0.58, "#377EB8",
      ifelse(data$logFC > 0.58, "#E41A1C",
        'black'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- 'High Myeloid'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- 'High Other'
  
EnhancedVolcano(data,
    lab = rownames(data),
    x = 'logFC',
    y = 'p_value_adj',
    title = 'Myeloid and non-myeloid cells',
    boxedLabels = TRUE,
    pCutoff = 0.0001,
    FCcutoff = 0.58,
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    pointSize = 4.0,
    labSize = 2.0, 
    colCustom = keyvals)
```

# 5. Differential abundance analysis 

## Loop over categories 

### Immune metacluster 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
library(ggnewscale)

DA_out$category <- factor(DA_out$category,levels = c("PDL1_score","necrose","pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))
#DA_out <- DA_out %>% filter(category %in% c("pT_combined","ISUP_combined"))

ggplot(DA_out, aes(x=cluster, y = category,col = logFC, size= -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "#E41A1C", mid = "white", low = "#377EB8")+
  scale_size(range = c(2,10))+
  new_scale_colour() +
  geom_point(data = DA_out,shape = 1,aes(size = -log10(FDR), col = result), stroke =1.5)+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("UP" = "#E41A1C",NOTSIG = "snow2", "DOWN" = "#377EB8"), name = "Direction")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

## ISUP grade 

For immune metaclusters

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$ISUP_combined <- relevel(x=factor(meta$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$ISUP_combined),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$ISUP_combined)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ISUP_combined, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined))%v%
  columnAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

```{r}
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$necrose <- relevel(x=factor(meta$necrose), ref = "0")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$necrose),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$necrose)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~necrose, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$necrose))%v%
  columnAnnotation(necrose = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$necrose)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("Necrose (0 vs 1)")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
    geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (Necrose: 0 vs 1)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change (best?)
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (Necrose: 0 vs 1)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```






# 6. Survival analysis 

## Multicollinearity test

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# Select all clinically relevant categories 
cox_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID, OS_months, status_OS, age, gender, ISUP_combined, pT_combined, necrose, PDL1_score) %>% unique() %>% select(-PID)

cox_df <- na.omit(cox_df)

# Basic cox model
basic_model <- coxph(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ age + gender + pT_combined + necrose, data = cox_df)

# Larger cox model 
multi_model <- coxph(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ age + gender + pT_combined + necrose + ISUP_combined + PDL1_score, data = cox_df)

# Log-likelihood ratio test to compare models 
anova(basic_model, multi_model)

# Test for multicollinearity using variance inflation factor 
## VIF > 5 would be concerning 
## Note that interpretation of VIF for categorical predictors is unclear 

library(faraway)
faraway::vif(model.matrix(multi_model))
```

Conclusion: For multivariate cox models, we should use (age + gender +) pT_combined + necrose as co-variates.


## Multivariate cox models

### Continious 

```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_immune_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_immune_metacluster <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "immune_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")



## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Based on proportions

#covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -gender, -age, -ISUP, -pT, -Unknown/Other) %>% colnames
#multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ gender + age + ISUP + pT +", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ Unknown/Other"))

covariates <- Cox_df %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -Stromal) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ Stromal"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

### Mean / Median 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_immune_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_immune_metacluster <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 

Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])

#Based on proportions
#covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -gender, -age, -ISUP, -pT, -Unknown/Other) %>% colnames

covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -Unknown_Other) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ Unknown_Other"))

                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),

                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))

geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
```
